notes: Use a Troika card for the metro (some of the world's most beautiful stations, worth a tour in themselves) and Yandex Go for taxis. Aeroexpress serves the airports.
Visa: Turkish citizens can stay 60 days visa-free; others need an e-visa. Foreign bank cards do not work (2026), so carry cash roubles or a MIR card. Google Pay is unavailable.
Summer brings 22-28°C and light until 22:00: perfect for parks, river boats and cycling in Gorky Park.
Pelmeni cost 400-600 RUB, a Georgian restaurant 1,500-2,500 and a stolovaya 300. Tip 10%.
Book the Kremlin and Armoury online 2 weeks ahead. Lenin's Mausoleum opens Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday mornings, with a 30-minute queue.
In churches, women should cover their heads and men remove their hats. Photography may be banned inside.

transit.name: Troika Card
transit.why_chosen: Covers the metro, buses and trams. Moscow's metro stations are among the most beautiful in the world.
transit.coverage: Moskova Metrosu, otobüs, tramvay, Aeroexpress ayrı

stops.name: Red Square
stops.tips: Come in the morning when the square is empty. Take in St. Basil's and the GUM façades, and Lenin's Mausoleum (Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday, 10:00-13:00).

stops.name: St. Basil's Cathedral
stops.tips: Onion-domed cathedral with narrow interior staircases and icons.

stops.name: Moscow Kremlin & Armoury
stops.tips: Kremlin cathedrals plus the Armoury (Fabergé eggs). Book online 2 weeks ahead. Closed Thursday; Armoury entry is timed.

stops.name: GUM Gastronom No.1
stops.tips: GUM's Soviet-themed food hall, with ice cream (plombir) and a cafeteria.

stops.name: Zaryadye Park Floating Bridge
stops.tips: Modern park beside the Kremlin, with a bridge over the river and an ice cave. Best at sunset.

backups.name: State Historical Museum
backups.tips: The red museum on Red Square. A good option if you have no Kremlin ticket.

stops.name: Tretyakov Gallery
stops.tips: Russian painting: Repin, Vrubel and icons (Rublev's Trinity). Closed Monday.

stops.name: Zamoskvorechye Streets
stops.tips: Old merchant district, with Pyatnitskaya Street and its churches.

stops.name: Lepim i Varim Pyatnitskaya
stops.tips: Handmade pelmeni (dumplings) with a range of fillings.

stops.name: Muzeon Park & Krymskaya Naberezhnaya
stops.tips: Soviet sculpture park (including the toppled Dzerzhinsky) and the riverside promenade.

stops.name: Gorky Park
stops.tips: Moscow's main park: cycling and dancing in summer, and Europe's largest ice rink in winter.

backups.name: Cafe Pushkin
backups.tips: Aristocratic Russian cuisine on Tverskoy. Book ahead.

backups.name: Garage Museum of Contemporary Art
backups.tips: Contemporary art in Gorky Park, in a building by Rem Koolhaas.

stops.name: Komsomolskaya Metro Station
stops.tips: Baroque station with mosaics. Start your metro tour here (with a Troika card).

stops.name: Mayakovskaya Metro Station
stops.tips: Art deco steel arches and ceiling mosaics.

stops.name: Ploshchad Revolyutsii Metro
stops.tips: Bronze statues. Rub the dog's nose.

stops.name: Arbat Street
stops.tips: Pedestrian street with matryoshka dolls, street musicians and Pushkin's house.

stops.name: Mari Vanna Moscow
stops.tips: Russian cuisine in a grandmother's-house setting: borscht and pelmeni.

backups.name: Pushkin Museum of Fine Arts
backups.tips: Impressionists and Egyptian collections. An alternative to Arbat.

stops.name: VDNKh
stops.tips: Soviet exhibition of achievements. See the Friendship of Nations fountain and the Kosmos pavilion (paid museum); the grounds are free.

stops.name: Museum of Cosmonautics
stops.tips: Beneath the Monument to the Conquerors of Space, with Gagarin and Sputnik.

stops.name: VDNKh Pavilion Cafeteria
stops.tips: Soviet-style stolovaya (canteen) inside the exhibition grounds, serving shashlik.

stops.name: Ostankino Tower
stops.tips: 540 m tower. Bring your passport; glass floor, timed entry.

backups.name: Botanical Garden VDNKh
backups.tips: Botanical garden next to the exhibition grounds. An alternative to the tower.

stops.name: Trinity Lavra of St. Sergius
stops.tips: 1 hour by train from Yaroslavsky Station. The centre of Russian Orthodoxy, with blue and gold domes and the shrine of St. Sergius. Bring a headscarf.

stops.name: Lavra Trapeznaya Dining Hall
stops.tips: Monastery refectory serving fish and kvass.

stops.name: Sergiev Posad Toy Museum
stops.tips: The birthplace of the matryoshka, with wooden toys.

stops.name: Blinnaya Gora Viewpoint
stops.tips: Postcard view of the monastery from a hilltop.

backups.name: Gostevaya Izba Sergiev Posad
backups.tips: Lunch in a traditional Russian izba (log house).

backups.name: Abramtsevo Estate
backups.tips: Artists' colony estate. An alternative to the museum, on the way.

stops.name: Kolomenskoye
stops.tips: Riverside tsarist estate with the Church of the Ascension (UNESCO), a replica wooden palace and apple orchards.

stops.name: Kolomenskoye Tea House
stops.tips: Samovar tea and blini in the park.

stops.name: Moscow City Federation Tower Panorama 360
stops.tips: Observation deck on the 89th floor, with free ice cream and views over the skyscraper district.

stops.name: Khachapuri Restaurant Bolshaya Gruzinskaya
stops.tips: Georgian chain serving khachapuri (cheese bread) and khinkali (dumplings), a Moscow favourite.

stops.name: Patriarch's Ponds
stops.tips: Bulgakov's pond, with cafés and an evening stroll.

backups.name: Novodevichy Convent
backups.tips: Red-walled convent and cemetery of famous figures. An alternative to the skyscrapers.

stops.name: Bolshoi Theatre
stops.tips: Façade and square. Performance tickets sell out months ahead; photograph it in the morning.

stops.name: Eliseevsky / Tverskaya
stops.tips: Tverskaya Street for coffee and souvenirs (Christmas atmosphere in winter).

stops.name: Cafe Pushkin Konditerskaya
stops.tips: Pushkin's pastry shop: cake and coffee for a farewell treat.

stops.name: Aeroexpress Belorussky
stops.tips: Aeroexpress to Sheremetyevo takes 35 minutes. Farewell.

backups.name: Dr. Zhivago Restaurant
backups.tips: Stylish Soviet-style breakfast at the National Hotel.

backups.name: Bunker-42
backups.tips: Cold War bunker tour. An alternative to the Bolshoi.
